name: empty and failed native stage grade
lua_assertions:
local p1 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P1')
local p2 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P2')
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
assert(p2:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
p1:SetDancePointLimits(8, 10)
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
p1:FailPlayer()
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Failed')
assert(p2:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17')
